scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names contracts,api,web "npm run dev --workspace @hub/contracts" "npm run dev --workspace @hub/api" "npm run dev --workspace @hub/web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @hub/contracts && npm run build --workspace @hub/api && npm run build --workspace @hub/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @hub/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run format:check && npm run build
scripts.db:migrate: npm run build --workspace @hub/contracts && npm run db:migrate --workspace @hub/api
